subject: ingles
statement:
Lee el texto original de práctica:
“The study club used to meet on Fridays. This term it meets on Wednesdays because the library room is free then. Members may also join online. The new schedule was announced on Monday, and the first Wednesday meeting starts at four.”

On which day does the club meet this term?
explanation:
1. La evidencia pertinente es: “This term it meets on Wednesdays”.
2. La pregunta pide el horario actual, no el anterior.
3. La respuesta respaldada por el texto es: Wednesday.

subject: ingles
statement:
Lee el texto original de práctica:
“After a school sports session, the coach asked students to report any discomfort to the responsible adult. Dani said his ankle hurt and sat down while the teacher called his family. The text does not describe a diagnosis or a treatment.”

What did Dani report?
explanation:
1. La evidencia pertinente es: “Dani said his ankle hurt”.
2. El texto describe una molestia, sin identificar su causa médica.
3. La respuesta respaldada por el texto es: Pain in his ankle.
